final: SELECT step1.rating, step1.avg_price_per_day, step1.films, step1.avg_price_per_day / step2.overall_avg as ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_price_per_day, COUNT(*) as films FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating) step1, (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_price_per_day FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating)) step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY step1.rating
